selection_rule: For each rate, damping, and method independently: fewest unconditional failures on selection shots; then least total initial-plus-extra C2V work; then lexicographically first profile ID. Freeze before evaluation.
evaluation_rule: All evaluation profiles run on matched, independent physical samples. Four selected Beam-versus-Relay rate/damping contrasts use two-sided exact paired McNemar tests and Holm familywise correction at alpha=0.05; all other contrasts are descriptive. Every terminal shot counts; exact and stabilizer-equivalent outcomes are successes.
limitations: BB72 X-only CSS code capacity is a controlled adaptation of the cited circuit-level experiments.
The common plain-BP initial run is separate from Relay's paper-defined first memory-BP leg.
A shared additional C2V update cap does not equalize total operations, runtime, or parallel latency.
Selection and evaluation physical sample namespaces are disjoint; no outcome-dependent stopping is allowed.
